capabilities: Render bullet-journal markers for tasks, events, and plain notes
Show migration (>) and future-log (<) symbols for moved tasks
Complete tasks or events by clicking the rendered marker
Style emotion or thought lines marked with a tilde
disambiguation: It only renders bullet-journal markers on task lines; it does not implement the full bullet-journal system of collections and logs.
extras: Known limitation: the plugin does not work with the Border theme.
intentEvidence: Render bullet-journal (BuJo) markers in your notes instead of Obsidian's checkboxes
problem: Obsidian renders Markdown tasks only as checkboxes, so bullet-journal users cannot see the paper-style symbols for migrated, scheduled, or event items.

relations.evidence: Inspired by obsidian-bujo-bullets by Frank Olson and Bullet Journaling by Ryder Carroll.

summary: Renders bullet-journal markers (notes, tasks, migration, future log, events, emotions) in place of checkboxes in Reading mode and Live Preview.
